title: Learning beside the bucket
summary: The link can change next to the bucket, without a round trip.

cards.text:
A tip is a small packet to another core.
It is not a number written in one giant notebook.

The unusual part is a learning rule that runs beside the link,
on the chip.

question.prompt: A diary read backward on a graphics chip is already this machine.
choices: No. The lesson has to be local.
question.why: Backprop’s diary is a different machine.
question.simpler: Local rule, local packets. That is the fit.

question.prompt: The 2018 paper’s energy story is about a specific sparse solver, not about every network.
question.why: Quote the task that was measured.
question.simpler: It is an existence proof, not a ranking of all models.

recall.question: What does Loihi put next to the synapses that a pure inference chip can skip?

deeper.note: Davies and colleagues, IEEE Micro 2018. 128 neuromorphic cores. Do not cite this paper as a description of the later Loihi 2 chip.

paper.title: Loihi: A Neuromorphic Manycore Processor with On-Chip Learning
paper.section: The core, the mesh, the learning engine, and what the energy comparison actually measured.

terms.definition: A weight update that runs locally on a neuromorphic core, without a host optimizer in the inner loop.
